title: Reveal-buffer >4 trim completely untested (r1 gap carries over)
detail: No unit test or golden forces >4 live reveals: spawn_feel_test asserts only len==1 and len==2, and the demo spawns 4 nodes total (buffer never exceeds 4), so an off-by-one or dropped trim ships green.
recommended_fix: Unit-test spawn_fx_feed with a 6-event slice: expect len(reveals)==4 and the two OLDEST ids dropped (ordered_remove index 0).

title: Reduced-motion telegraph + highlight branches untested; highlight code contradicts its doc (r1 gap carries over)
detail: Only the reveal branch is pinned (spawn_fx_test.odin:348 asserts reveal_transform). The telegraph static-ring (line 336) and highlight (line 435) branches have no test and no golden (a11y_reduced.dem lacks 'growth on'), letting the code diverge from the documented 'steady band'.
recommended_fix: Pin both branches (telegraph draws static annulus; highlight draws steady band or nothing — reconcile doc vs early-return), and add a growth-enabled reduced-motion capture to a11y_reduced.dem.

title: Topology-gen re-predict leg and app-side feed/predict glue untested
evidence:
if !force && fx.predicted_window == window && fx.predicted_gen == state.topology.gen {
		return // already predicted for this window + topology
	}
--- app/main.odin:485-490 ---
rnd.spawn_fx_feed(&app.view, app.state.events[app.audio_mark:], &app.state.topology, app.tick)
...
app.audio_mark = len(app.state.events)
detail: test_spawn_fx_predict_dedup covers only the same-state no-op and force. Nothing bumps topology.gen mid-window to prove the ring retargets, and the app call-site ordering (feed before audio_mark advance) is untestable by any current suite — a swap silently no-ops the feature live while goldens stay green.
recommended_fix: Unit-test: predict, apply a topology edit (gen bump), predict again non-forced — telegraph must re-predict with the new gen. Add an app-loop smoke test pinning feed-before-mark ordering.

title: #83-merge tint path and shadow ink-ratio fade pinned only by composite goldens, no unit pin
detail: No *_test.odin references tint/sprite_blit/sprite_shadow (grep-verified). The reveal-bearing goldens (04000/04100ms) byte-pin the composite, but the ink-ratio fade math (ink×alpha/255) has no isolated unit pin.
recommended_fix: Add a small unit pin on the fade math: sprite_shadow alpha == u8(ink×fade/255) at fade 1.0/0.5/0.3, and default-arg call sites stay backward-compatible.
